title: The Offside Trap — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The offside trap is a collective act of confidence
Eleven men stepping forward at exactly the same moment
Trusting that none of them will flinch

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
一人が躊躇する [One man who hesitates]
一人が半秒遅れて残る [One man who stays back half a second]
そしてトラップはプレゼントになる [And the trap becomes a gift]
美しく、高価なプレゼント [A beautiful, expensive gift]

[Chorus — English]
The offside trap says — we are one unit
The offside trap says — we move together
Step, now, together
One second later — the trap has either worked or it hasn't

[Bridge — 中文]
边裁的旗帜就是裁决 [The linesman's flag is the verdict]
举起 — 陷阱成功了 [Up — the trap worked]
放下 — 有人犹豫了 [Down — someone hesitated]
一支完全信任彼此的后防线 [A back four that trusts each other completely]
这比他们试图阻止的事情更难得 [That's rarer than the thing they're trying to stop]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas said — it's the most optimistic thing in football
A back four that trusts each other completely

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The offside trap
オフサイドトラップ [The offside trap]
越位陷阱 [The offside trap]
That's my boy
